scoring_justification: The verifier sandbox cannot rerun the DFT workflow; scoring compares the agent's submitted computed_results.json against paper-reported gold values with generous tolerances, plus required directional relations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported equilibrium structural parameters, bulk moduli, band gaps, total energies for rutile and anatase with TM and Teter pseudopotentials.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Tables I and II and explicit numerical values in the text of 'First-Principles Study of Titanium Dioxide: Rutile and Anatase', DOI 10.1143/jjap.39.l847.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper tables and the text's energy numbers; exact values as printed (including the rounded 1.38 and 1.13 kcal/mol energy differences).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers; the solver is expected to reproduce them within tolerances consistent with pseudopotential and implementation variations.

schema.description: JSON with top-level keys rutile_TM, rutile_Teter, anatase_TM, anatase_Teter, energy_TM, energy_Teter. Each polymorph-pseudopotential key is an object with numeric properties a, c, c_over_a, u, density, bulk_modulus, band_gap, gap_direct (boolean). Energy difference keys contain E_rutile, E_anatase, difference_kcal_per_mol, difference_sign_convention (string, value 'E_anatase_minus_E_rutile').

outputs.description: Aggregated structural, elastic, electronic and energetic properties of rutile and anatase TiO2 computed with TM and Teter pseudopotentials.

output_contract.notes: All numeric values in stated units; energy differences sign convention is E_anatase_minus_E_rutile.
